name: Akinator
description: Mira's friend, the Akinator genie will read your mind.

choose_thematic.description: Start an Akinator game and let the owner choose a thematic category.

setup.description: Set up the Akinator game with the chosen thematic and begin questioning.

guess.description: Have the Akinator make a guess based on the answers so far.

retry.description: Retry the Akinator game after a completed or failed round.
